body.statement: Assume \(\alpha+\beta<2d\gamma/(4\gamma+d)\). Characterize the exact minimax rate within this strict rough regime, including whether \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) enter separately through further elbows and whether logarithmic factors occur at any additional boundary or interior elbow. For sequences with \(V(P_n)\asymp r_n^2\), compare Yu's procedure only on laws satisfying both \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{Yu},n}(P_n)\) and \(\mathsf Y_n\), and record separately its requirement \(\sqrt n\,r_n^2\to\infty\). Compare Dhawan--Guo--Shah only on laws satisfying \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}(P_n)\), its conditional correlation event above \(\kappa_n\), and \(n\kappa_n^2r_n^2\to\infty\). Establish a strict inclusion or non-inclusion only through legal sequences that also satisfy the relevant published applicability predicate; otherwise leave that relation unresolved. Distinguish uniform omnibus power from favorable-direction pointwise power.

obligation.what_is_open: Within \(\alpha+\beta<2d\gamma/(4\gamma+d)\), the exact minimax phase map, any separate dependence on \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\), any logarithmic factors at further elbows, and strict inclusion or non-inclusion relations with the Yu and Dhawan--Guo--Shah applicability classes.
obligation.obstruction: The exact phase map depends on the unresolved nuisance-scale observational converse. In addition, a bump pack can be orthogonalized against one fixed direction, but the hunted direction is training-sample random, and the published regularity predicates contain learner, variance, boundary, nondegeneracy, and moment conditions not implied by membership in the frozen observed-law class.
obligation.attempted: The achieved upper-envelope boundary was derived algebraically; the Dhawan--Guo--Shah score, energy, conditional correlation requirement, and signal requirement were separated; and Yu's learner and root-\(n\) signal requirements were separated. No sequence was certified to satisfy every relevant published applicability condition while also proving the requested strict relation.
obligation.partial_result:
Let \(s=\alpha+\beta\).  The proved upper endpoint is oracle-sized exactly when
\[
 s\ge \frac{2d\gamma}{4\gamma+d},
\]
and in the strict complementary regime it has exponent
\[
 a_{\mathrm{nu}}=
 \frac{4\gamma s}{4\gamma s+ds+2d\gamma}.
\]
This characterizes the achieved bracket, not the unknown sharp frontier in that complementary regime.  For a sequence satisfying \(V(P_n)\asymp r_n^2\), the Dhawan--Guo--Shah implication additionally requires \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}(P_n)\), the conditional correlation event with lower bound \(\kappa_n\), and \(n\kappa_n^2r_n^2\to\infty\); the score-translation lemma and overlap give energy equivalence but no uniform direction-correlation lower bound.  Yu's implication likewise remains conditional on both \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{Yu},n}(P_n)\) and \(\mathsf Y_n\), with the separate signal requirement \(\sqrt n\,r_n^2\to\infty\).

At the proved oracle endpoint,
\[
 \sqrt n\,r_{\mathrm{or}}(n)^2
 =n^{1/2-4\gamma/(4\gamma+d)},
\]
which diverges exactly for \(\gamma<d/4\), is of constant order for \(\gamma=d/4\), and vanishes for \(\gamma>d/4\).  At the achieved nuisance endpoint,
\[
 \sqrt n\,r_{\mathrm{nu}}(n)^2
 =n^{1/2-8\gamma s/(4\gamma s+ds+2d\gamma)},
\]
which diverges exactly when \(ds+2d\gamma>12\gamma s\), is of constant order at equality, and vanishes when the inequality is reversed.  These are arithmetic consequences of the proved endpoints; they neither establish the learner predicates nor turn favorable-direction pointwise power into uniform omnibus power.

body.justification: This question separates unknown rough-regime minimax geometry from sufficient learner, variance, direction, and signal conditions for existing first-order procedures.
body.gap: The sharp rough-regime rate is unknown, and the Yu and Dhawan--Guo--Shah applicability predicates are not implied by the frozen full class, so strict relations require separately certified legal sequences.
body.consumer: A resolution would refine only the rough-regime phase map and would distinguish uniform omnibus detectability from favorable-direction pointwise power.
